## The claim

P4-24: the D5 drugs found from the child's phenotype twin (dasatinib, mTOR inhibitors) show a selectivity pattern in PRISM that the report can state honestly, whatever its direction

**Prediction if true.** both are present in PRISM and their RMS and aneuploidy contrasts are reported with effect size and p-value, whichever way they point

**What would refute it.** neither drug is in PRISM, so the screen cannot speak to D5 and the entry says so
